_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to %USERPROFILE%\.copilot\state\arc1-connections.json and fill in. The copy lives outside every repository and is gitignored. One block per SAP logon, the same shape as ABAP FS abapfs.remote. Add or remove a logon with sap-connection.ps1 rather than by hand: it validates the fields and tells you which secret to store.
_password_rule: "@secret" means the value is in Windows Credential Manager as ARC1:<name>_SAP_PASSWORD. Store it with: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File sap-secret.ps1 -Set -Key <name>_SAP_PASSWORD . Any other value is plaintext, and verify-all.ps1 section 9 reports it.
_active_rule: "active" is the logon a launcher uses when it is started without -Connection.
